udt_struct_v0.doc:
The withdrawal context binds a proof to a specific execution environment.
- `processooor`: the relayer (or withdrawer contract) authorized to submit the tx
- `recipient`: the final recipient account or contract
- `fee_recipient`: the relayer to be paid the fee
- `relay_fee_bps`: relayer fee in basis points (of `withdrawn_value`, /10_000)
- `min_xlm_out`: XLM the withdrawer buys to fund the recipient (0 = no swap)
- `max_x_in`: most pool tokens the withdrawer may spend buying `min_xlm_out`
- `deadline`: last ledger timestamp at which the withdrawal may execute
- `scope`: the pool being withdrawn from
- `delivery`: direct, recipient-authorized setup, or deferred collection

The context is hashed on-chain and compared against the proof's committed context value,
preventing front-running and ensuring the proof can only be used in this exact context.
udt_struct_v0.name: WithdrawContext
